messages:
alex (infra): Heads-up: scheduling a short rolling reboot across az11 GPU nodes to clear a kernel-level NIC queue/backpressure issue we've been seeing. Window: Mon 2025-10-13 03:00-06:00 UTC. Expect brief pod evictions and transient 429s for non-critical jobs.

maya (oncall): Can you confirm which pools are affected? Any Dedicated customers in az11 we need to notify separately?

alex (infra): Impacted pools: gpu-pool-az11-general, gpu-pool-az11-burst. Dedicated customers on gpu-dedicated-az11 get automatic failover to az10/az12 per routing policy (we've tested). We'll DM account teams for customers with pinned regions.

trent (sre): What's the rollback plan if drains cause longer-than-expected evictions? Also share backfill prioritization so batch jobs don't saturate other regions.

alex (infra): Rollback: cancel remaining drains, uncordon nodes, and run a fast-kernel-repro to verify. Backfill: we'll enable capacity-limit-shed: set elastic-burst to 0.2 and deprioritize batch queues via scheduler weight.

evie (platform): Suggest we do a 2-node canary at 03:00 for 30m, verify model latency/kv-cache warmup, then proceed in 10-node cohorts. Also will attach a live dashboard link in the schedule.

alex (infra): Plan:
- 03:00 UTC canary (2 nodes)
- 03:30-05:30 UTC cohorts of 10 nodes (stagger 5m between cohorts)
- 05:30-06:00 UTC soak + final verification
Commands we'll run:
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-az11-3
kubectl drain node/gpu-az11-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=15m
ssh ops@gpu-az11-3 'sudo systemctl restart network && sudo reboot'
```
Logs to watch: dmesg for NIC queue drops, /var/log/syslog for firmware messages.

maya (oncall): I'll stand by for canary and confirm traffic shaping. Can someone drop the exact dashboard URL?

evie (platform): dashboard: https://console.redwood-inference.internal/d/infra/az11-egress?orgId=1 (will post after scheduling). I'll also add an automated smoke check: 50 small generation calls per second to warm KV cache and ensure latency < 120ms post-reboot.

alex (infra): Cost note: expected token cost delta during warmups ~+6-8% for the window due to cache misses and cross-region fallback. I logged that in the maintenance ticket.

trent (sre): Add me to the oncall rotation for the window. I'll be watching packet drops and egress qdisc stats: `tc -s qdisc show dev eth0`. If we see >5000 drops/min we pause cohort and revert.

infra-scheduler-bot: Maintenance scheduled by alex (infra) for 2025-10-13 03:00-06:00 UTC. Canary enabled. Notifying relevant owners.

maya (oncall): Thanks. I'll send the customer-facing notice to the impacted teams and post in #incidents if any customer-facing degradations appear.

alex (infra): Cool. Will ping here when canary completes. TL;DR: rolling reboots in az11 to clear NIC queue/backpressure, canary at 03:00, cohorts after. Expect short evictions and slight cost uptick during warmup.
